title: DFlash2 vs MTP: 256K code prompt
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16 GiB; Linux; Strata engine 0.1.47
prompt_method: Qwen shipped tokenizer over 90 non-repeating source files. src/core/dflash_runtime.cpp and src/core/mtp.cpp plus spec headers are first; remaining code files from src/, include/, serve/, tools/ fill the prompt. Last file truncated at token boundary.
caveat: One full prompt per method due ~17 minute prompt processing. Decode TPS is a single sample; no statistical interval. Both arms use the same prompt, model binary, expert profile, 2700 expert slots, context, resident KV, prefill, and seed. Per-method established proposal settings differ (DFlash block7 / threshold0.7; MTP maxT4 / threshold0.5).
